meta.title: FrankenPHP: the modern PHP app server
meta.description: FrankenPHP is a new app server for PHP apps (built on top of Caddy) and a library to embed the PHP interpreter in Go web servers.

hero.title: The modern PHP app server, written in Go.
hero.subtitle: One binary that boots your app once and keeps it alive. Worker mode, automatic HTTPS, HTTP/3 and Early Hints, stitched together on top of Caddy.
hero.pill: Officially supported by The PHP Foundation
hero.platforms: Free and open source. Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows and FreeBSD.

gettingStarted.title: One command to run them all.
gettingStarted.content: A production-grade PHP server in one command. No PHP-FPM, no Nginx, no glue: copy your PHP files into the document root and you're done.
gettingStarted.docker:
# Serve the public/ directory
docker run -v $PWD:/app/public \
  -p 443:443/tcp -p 443:443/udp \
  dunglas/frankenphp

# Run a command-line script
docker run -v $PWD:/app \
  dunglas/frankenphp php script.php
gettingStarted.standard:
# Install FrankenPHP on Linux or macOS
curl https://frankenphp.dev/install.sh | sh

# Or on Windows, with PowerShell
irm https://frankenphp.dev/install.ps1 | iex

# Serve the public/ directory
frankenphp php-server -r public/

anatomy.title: Anatomy of a modern PHP server.
anatomy.content: Every part was stitched on for a reason. Here's what keeps the creature alive.
anatomy.caption: One binary. No PHP-FPM.

parts.title: Automatic HTTPS
parts.content: Certificates issued, renewed and revoked for you, with Let's Encrypt or ZeroSSL.

parts.title: Worker mode
parts.content: Boots your app once and keeps it in memory, ready in milliseconds.

parts.title: Caddy inside
parts.content: The official PHP executor sewn into Caddy, with every Caddy module at hand.

parts.title: 103 Early Hints
parts.content: Spots the assets a page needs and tells the browser before the response is ready.

parts.title: Real-time
parts.content: A built-in Mercure hub pushes events from PHP to every connected browser.

parts.title: HTTP/3 & compression
parts.content: HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 by default, with zstd, Brotli and gzip built in.

worker.title:
Boot it once.
It stays alive.
worker.content: Worker mode boots your application a single time and keeps it in memory. Every request after that skips the bootstrap, using plain old superglobals: no PSR-7 required.
worker.statText: faster than PHP-FPM on API Platform apps, according to our benchmarks.

items.title: Straightforward
items.content: Supported natively by Laravel Octane, Symfony and API Platform.

items.title: Efficient
items.content: Written in Go and C, built on Go's iconic goroutines.

items.title: Optional
items.content: Apps that aren't worker-ready are served as-is, in classic mode.

items.title: Easy deploy
items.content: Runs in process: one binary, no external service needed.

items.title: Watcher
items.content: Workers restart automatically each time your code changes.

items.title: Self-healing
items.content: Restart a worker after N requests to keep memory leaks in check.

config.title: Three lines. Production-grade.
config.content: That's all it takes to run a production-grade PHP server, powered by Caddy.

items.title: Only one service
items.content: No PHP-FPM: FrankenPHP uses its own SAPI, handcrafted for Go web servers.

items.title: Extensible
items.content: PHP 8.2+, most PHP extensions and all Caddy modules. Write extensions in Go, too.

items.title: Easy deploy
items.content: A Docker image, Kubernetes, or your whole app as one static binary.

items.title: Worker mode
items.content: Boot once, then answer each request in a few milliseconds.

items.title: 103 Early Hints
items.content: The only PHP SAPI with Early Hints, for pages that start loading sooner.

items.title: Real-time
items.content: A built-in Mercure hub sends events from PHP to every browser.

items.title: Modern compression
items.content: Zstandard, Brotli and gzip, supported out of the box.

items.title: Structured logging
items.content: Logs with a defined format and the details you need.

items.title: Metrics & tracing
items.content: Built-in Prometheus support, with no extra service to run.

items.title: HTTP/2 & HTTP/3
items.content: Native support for HTTPS, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3.

items.title: HTTPS automation
items.content: Certificates generated, renewed and revoked automatically.

items.title: Graceful reload
items.content: Deploy with zero downtime thanks to graceful reloads.

go.title: Born in a lab. Written in Go.
go.content: FrankenPHP is a Caddy module and a library: embed the PHP interpreter in any Go program and serve PHP scripts through net/http.
go.cta: Use FrankenPHP as a Go library

modern.title: Moderner PHP than ever!
items: Runs the official PHP interpreter inside Caddy, a state-of-the-art web server.
Supports HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 natively, with automatic HTTPS certificates.
Copy your PHP files into the document root, and you're done.
Builds standalone, self-executable binaries of your web apps and CLI tools.
Works out of the box with popular extensions, including OPcache and Xdebug.

hosting.title: Hosting your projects with FrankenPHP
hosting.content:
We deploy and manage your PHP apps in production and take care of everything: monitoring, enforcing security, upgrading, optimizing performance…

In addition, we can manage your applications to the cloud technologies that best suit your needs (Kubernetes, GCP, AWS…) or your on premise servers.

services.title: A wide range of PHP services
services.content:
FrankenPHP is sponsored by Les-Tilleuls.coop, a French-based IT services company specializing in APIs, e-commerce, web, and cloud.

We are the creators of API Platform, co-maintainers of Symfony, members of the PHP Foundation’s advisory board, and contributors to more than 100 open-source solutions (Laravel, Kubernetes, PM2, Go…).

go.title: We are Go lovers
go.content: We are also major contributors to Go. We created Mercure, a simplified real-time open protocol and reference implementation written in this language, and Vulcain, an open protocol for fast and idiomatic client-driven REST APIs.
